newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish PM says don't expect simple EMU yes or no.
newsitem.headline: Swedish PM says don't expect simple EMU yes or no.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Wednesday that when his Social Democrat party announces a stance on Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU), it will be more than a simple yes or no.
He also said the decision was likely to be backed by a majority in the Swedish parliament.
"I believe it will be quite an easy decision," Persson told reporters in connection with a construction industry seminar in the Swedish city of Norrkoping.
"It will be a more comprehensive decision rather than 'yes' or 'no' and we will be able to gather support from a parliamentary majority for the decision," he said.
He said that he had already formulated a personal view on EMU. He also repeated that public opinion would become more favourable towards EMU as the Swedish economy improved.
"We are in the midst of an improved economic situation right now. In connection with this upturn I believe that public opinion towards EMU will turn. How far still remains to be seen," Persson said.
